'''Zhenjian''' is a male Black Shore NPC found at the [[TD Observatory]], [[The Black Shores]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Zhenjian}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Zhenjian''' The corrupted data at the Anchor has been cleared, and the backlog of anomaly data is finally running smoothly again.
:{{DIcon}} Anomaly data?
:'''Zhenjian''' Yes, it's a collection of data on Reverberations, Tacet Discords, and other anomalies caused by the Lament.
:{{DIcon}} What can we do with it?
:'''Zhenjian''' For example, with Tethys' computing power, we can build evolutionary models of the Tacet Discords to predict how they might develop in the future. 
:'''Zhenjian''' We can also input Reverberations gathered from the Lament zone into Tethys to recreate those areas in the [[Tethys System|Sand Table]].
:'''Zhenjian''' But from what we've observed so far, the Sand Table has its limits.
:'''Zhenjian''' The more ancient the Lament, the more diluted the Reverberations are, which makes it harder to replicate the affected areas accurately.
:'''Zhenjian''' Still, I believe this is just the beginning of what Tethys can do. There's much more potential to tap. 
{{Dialogue End}}
